verdict.rationale: Productboard documents custom drivers and data fields such as value, risk, impact, confidence, and effort on features and initiatives, which covers scoring ideas. The only evidence is a single mention in the MCP server context, and nothing shows these fields applied to feedback itself. Missing for 10: scoring fields on feedback items, in-app scoring and prioritization UI documentation, details on how scores are configured and calculated, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can score feedback and ideas using fields like value, risk, impact, confidence, and effort

citations.quote: Update custom drivers and other data fields on features and initiatives (like value, risk, impact, confidence, and effort) to automate prioritization workflows.
